overview: In this TV comedy and after spending the last decade in Toronto, George (Adam Beach) decides to return to his remote Northern Quebec community of Moose to manage the local community television station. Despite his rough edges and a moral compass that needs repairing on occasion his boyish charm and enduring optimism make him a born leader. Moose TV is on-air, and life in the sleepy little town of Moose will never be the same again.
title: Moose TV

overview: Historian Bettany Hughes looks at the struggles between man and the environment on the British Isles since 6000 BCE. In collaboration with some of the country's top archaeologists and historians, here's the unofficial history of Britain.
title: Seven Ages of Britain

overview: Brigid Gallagher travels NZ to visit a different heritage site each week. Along with her team, Brigid gets the exhibition organised, creating new exhibits and uncovering fascinating stories.
title: Heritage Rescue

overview: Historian and author Bettany Hughes, reveals spectacular monuments from her December 2019 trip to explore to ancient Egypt.
title: Greatest Treasures of the Ancient World

overview: Enlightening six-part factual series that digs deep to uncover the blurred lines between fact and fiction, questioning long-held beliefs in both the modern and ancient world.
title: History's Greatest Myths

overview: Think you know the person you married? Think again. These gripping true stories explore the wickedness behind the wedding and show the devastating consequences of what happens when people are betrayed by those who should love them the most.
title: Married to Evil

overview: An in-depth look at the stories behind the most momentous events, remarkable ideas and extraordinary people in history. Using carefully chosen archive footage, each episode focuses on a single theme.
title: Behind History

overview: Naked Attraction is the show where planning a perfect first date outfit does not matter. Instead, it is the naked body that's in focus. We are far from the polished digital persona, which is presented in social media on, for example, Tinder or in the Instagram world. Here, instead, all appearances are rewarded and nudity is de-dramatized.
title: Naked Attraction Sverige

overview: Naked Attraction Suomi shakes up the traditional concept of dating. What happens when you take off your clothes on a first date and put on the roles at the same time? A group of brave men and women from different parts of Finland are giving themselves up to a new kind of dating experience.
title: Naked Attraction Suomi

overview: Koichi Kawato is the new Japanese Literature teacher at the ill-famed Futakotamagawa high school, whose baseball club is composed of thugs and bullies who have been suspended for a year from all school competitions, for causing a brawl during an official match. The newly appointed teacher finds that the club members left are only interested in women, smoking and doing nothing until, under Kawato's guidance, they discover their dream of going to the Koshien high school baseball tournament. However, the road to Koshien is far from easy as many obstacles await them.
title: Rookies

overview: In the new crime series Anoniem, history teacher Jurre and Sarah Jansen each battle the criminal world in their own way. Although the two have been married for years, they keep their double life a secret from each other in order to protect each other and their family. The situation is getting more and more dangerous and their children are no longer safe either.
title: Anoniem

overview: Thirty years ago, hardened criminal Yip Siu-tin is arrested for armed robbery and sentenced to prison. Siu-tin's daughter, who has handled the loot, changes her name to Cheung Sum-yuet and starts a new life. She also gets married to yacht company boss Yen Ho-yin. Meanwhile, Chong Chi-kiu is a kid left behind by an accomplice who has died because of the robbery. Kind-hearted Tang Sing-him becomes his foster parent. A traffic accident causes Chi-kiu and Sum-yuet to run into each other again. But this accident somehow has something to do with Siu-tin, who is just released from prison. Sum-yuet can no longer avoid Siu-tin, who is a nightmare to her. Her marriage also has certain issues. Police officer Yeung Yan-hiu intervenes by launching an investigation, and she keeps going after Siu-tin and Chi-kiu. Unresolved grudges for thirty years are again put on the front burner. Everyone implicated in a robbery of yesteryear is drawn into this mess.
title: Secret Door

overview: The gripping story of Tarik, who wants to take revenge on his brother's murderer, and Elif, who cannot face the fact that the only thing to hold on to in life is the murderer, meets the audience with Fedakar. Elif, who lost her mother at a young age, is a devoted sister who supports her siblings Sefer and Narin. While Elif leads a life full of difficulties, she loses her younger sister Narin and only Sefer remains with her. While the two brothers are holding on to each other, Elif is suddenly devastated by the allegation that her sister Sefer is the murderer. The happy and peaceful life of Tarik, the sole heir of Karaca Holding, one of the few companies in Turkey, suddenly changes with the murder of his older sister, whom he loves dearly. Tarik kidnaps Elif to catch Sefer, who went missing because she thought that Sefer killed her older sister Yesim. While Tariq swears to avenge his sister, Elif and Tarik set sail for an impossible love. Will time help break down the insurmountable obstacles? Will the power of love be enough to forget the sibling pain? Will Elif's mercy heal Tarik's wounds?
title: Fedakar

overview: La Teniente centers on Mexican Naval graduate Lieutenant Roberta Ballesteros, the series shows the challenges facing her immediate and emotional entry into the elite Special Operations unit after a violent tragedy occurs to the group. The series follows her assimilation into the unit, which is filled with drama, action, love triangles, heroes and family.
title: La Teniente

overview: Salvador Espinoza, a young soccer player from Ocotlán, Jalisco, arrives in Mexico City searching for soccer super-stardom. After his great performance in the Sub-20 World Cup, the best soccer clubs in the country are fighting to sign him in their teams. Now, Chava must prepare for the unstable, seductive and exciting world of Mexican soccer.
title: El Diez

overview: El Equipo blends action, drama, love, and shows the work and effort of the Mexican federal police, who every day risk their lives to protect society. The story centers around Santiago, Fermin, Magda and Mateo, who at one time in his life made the decision to become a Federal Police officer. In each chapter, the team will solve a different case where we can see the intelligence process, the operation and the capture of the offender while the characters must face their feelings and solve their own problems of everyday life.
title: El Equipo

overview: A brand-new observational documentary series following the exceptional people behind His Majesty's Maritime and Coastguard Agency. With exclusive access and 12 months in the making, we follow the multiple team organisation across the length and breadth of the UK. From daring Search and Rescue helicopter incidents to fatal criminal maritime investigations, as well as survey inspectors examining and detaining fishing trawlers to commercial tankers and the ever-tense 999 mayday operations centre where nail-biting stories playout. We follow this and more as the MCA protects and responds to incidents and accidents on our shores.
title: Coastguard: Every Second Counts

overview: 14 celebrities compete to impress legendary culinary judges in a confectionery reality show setting.
title: Bake Off Brasil: Celebridades

overview: Iwase Ken and Yoshida Rei have been friends since elementary school. Ken is obstinate and unskilled in love, but he fell long ago for the lively and cheerful Rei. But Rei is about to get married to another man. While Ken and other friends from high-school attend the wedding ceremony, a fairy appears and sends Ken back in time, giving him a second chance to win the girl he loves.
title: Proposal Daisakusen

overview: One of the most appealing features of Japan's national road network is the various Michinoeki, literally way stations, that provide a place for motorists to rest, dine and shop. They offer information on the locality and restaurants with regional specialties, and often sell local crafts and delicacies for travelers to take home. A stop at one or more of these spots helps to make any road trip in Japan unforgettable.
title: Hit the Road

overview: Jay Blades explores the extraordinary history of his home – the east end of London. From law makers, to law breakers Jay finds out about the people who made the East End so special.
title: Jay Blades: East End Through Time

overview: In Dying for Revenge, each episode of this true crime series recounts a shocking story of a crime committed as an act of revenge. From a worker humiliated by a colleague, to a woman facing ruin when an ex-partner sells their home, the trigger events are different but the consequences are the same: being wronged leads to murder. Illustrated with evocative drama reconstruction, location filming and archive footage, each story is told through interviews with family and friends, insights from detectives who solved each case, and analysis from expert criminologists.
title: Dying for Revenge

overview: Police Rescue Australia pulls back the curtain on the often traumatic and high-risk incidents faced by these elite officers, who put their lives on the line daily to keep Australians safe. The series follows the unit's operations within the Sydney and Blue Mountains regions of New South Wales. Viewers can expect a broad range of dramatic scenarios, from mountain and cliff helicopter rescues and searching for missing persons in the breathtaking Blue Mountains, to managing sieges, defusing bombs, and abseiling down the iconic Sydney Harbour Bridge. Police Rescue Australia promises to provide an emotional, action-packed journey as these officers navigate the daily trials and dangers inherent in their critical roles.
title: Police Rescue Australia

overview: Eighty-seven-year-old adventurer Tim Slessor sets out to recreate his own 1955 record-breaking drive from London to Singapore - in the same badly behaved old Land Rover. What could possibly go wrong?
title: The Last Overland

overview: This four-part history series looks at how Australia has been shaped by its many definitions of home.
title: The Homes That Built Australia

overview: Megumi Noda, or "Nodame" is a piano student at Momogaoka College of Music. An extremely talented pianist who wants to be a preschool teacher, she prefers playing by ear rather than reading the music score. She is messy and disorganized. Shinichi Chiaki is Momogaoka's top student. Born into a musical family, he is talented in piano and violin and has secret ambitions to become a conductor. An arrogant multi-lingual perfectionist who once lived abroad in the music capitals of the world as a young boy, he is trapped in Japan because of his childhood phobia of airplanes and the ocean. They meet by accident and sparks fly!
title: Nodame Cantabile

overview: The puppet has no heart, so he let the manipulator live and kill. How did the girl with a miserable life experience pry the bloodthirsty and cold door of her heart, and how the river of love leads to the sea of bitterness, without knowing the pain.
title: Chang Xia Wei Yang

overview: Professional and personal lives of female police officers of Naperville Police Department, Illinois.
title: Female Forces

overview: Actress and fashion maven Vivica A. Fox searches for the next great celebrity stylist from a pool of aspiring stylistas who undergo a series of challenges that test their ability to put together a perfect top-to-toe look that includes hair, makeup and wardrobe. The winning stylist receives $100,000.
title: Glam God with Vivica A. Fox

overview: Fresh perspectives on lesser-known parts of Japan. This time, pafe, Japan's unique take on the parfait, introduced by a fan from Finland. You won't believe all the layers pafe have to offer.
title: Smitten in Japan

overview: Journalist Anders Agger and chef Anne Hjernøe travel to what was once Danish: the West Indies, Southern Schleswig, Southern Sweden and Iceland.
title: Anne og Anders på sporet af det tabte land

overview: We grew up with the Middle East as a bloody focal point. But perhaps we have forgotten that the area is so infinitely more than chaos and conflict. In four broadcasts, Anne and Anders try to travel away from the fronts and prejudices and into the nuances of a different Middle East.
title: Anne og Anders i Mellemøsten

overview: TV journalist Anders Agger and TV chef Anne Hjernøe go on a road trip to find home for the handheld summer vacation in Denmark. They have borrowed an old wagon rye bread with a top speed of 90 and are rolling around the country from Skagen to Sydfyn. With coffee breaks, forgotten dirt roads and small, seductive food experiences.
title: Anne og Anders på sommerferie

overview: TV journalist Anders Agger and TV chef Anne Hjernøe go on holiday with the new Danes. Return to Vietnam, Iran, Turkey and Bosnia. Back to the roots and to everything they left behind: family, love and food.
title: Anne og Anders tilbage til rødderne

overview: TV journalist Anders Agger and TV chef Anne Hjernøe visit four Danish/American families in four very different states: Arizona, South Carolina, Montana and Michigan. The families talk about their journey to the USA, and Anne and Anders go on a discovery of the state's cuisine, history and meet interesting people on their way.
title: Anne og Anders i USA

overview: Ryou Naruse is a two-faced lawyer: on the surface, he is a kind-hearted soul, representing the poor and earning the nickname "The Angelic Lawyer" from the press; but unbeknownst to anyone else, he is also a "devil," meticulously plotting the perfect revenge against those responsible for his younger brother's death. Naoto Serizawa is a gung-ho detective whose overzealous methods mask a dark past which he is trying to overcome. When a family acquaintance of Serizawa's is murdered, Serizawa is thrust in the middle of a multiple-homicide case which stirs up memories of a dark event from his past - and Naruse's.
title: Maou

overview: In four programmes, TV journalist Anders Agger and TV chef Anne Hjernøe travel to the UK that few of us know. Here they visit a number of Danish/British families in Wales, England, Northern Ireland and Scotland to find out why the British no longer want to be part of the EU. And why we will miss them.
title: Anne og Anders i Brexitland

overview: "ClickClack Show" is the TV version of the popular YouTube project. Not only the regular participants (Eldar Jarakhov, Yuri Muzychenko, Ilya Satir, Andrei Stariy, Danya Kraster and Andrei Prokofyev), but also the guest stars will be tested. Project host and showrunner Ruslan Usachev prepared a lot of crazy contests: the race on the walker, the run on the sticky floor, the battle in the Coliseum, giant cakes, ice pool with a surprise, jumping through breaking glass, the shower of insects, the electric shock test and much more.
title: КликКлак шоу

overview: A fascinating journey through the lives and works of Latin American idols, from the curious insights of young artists with access to exclusive material.
title: Bios, Vidas que marcaron la tuya

overview: Our new TV program helps you learn about Japan and the Japanese language through simple and easy Japanese news. You will learn not only Japanese expressions but also the latest situation of Japan.
title: Learn Japanese from the News

overview: A humorous show from VK Video in the genre of Late Night Show. Popular comedians will discuss current events, news and joke with star guests
title: КСТАТИ

overview: Paddy Gower tackles the issues facing New Zealanders. He's joined in studio by Newshub reporters, and comedians Karen O'Leary, Eli Matthewson and Courtney Dawson.
title: Paddy Gower Has Issues

overview: BOSAI is disaster prevention through preparedness. What did Japan learn from past floods, earthquakes, the 2011 tsunami and Fukushima Daiichi nuclear disaster? This program serves as a message from Japan to the world.
title: BOSAI: An Educational Journey

overview: The Blacklist is a crime drama involving a former government agent who turned into a high-profile criminal turning himself in to the FBI offering to help catch criminals.
title: The Blacklist

overview: A groundbreaking American television sitcom, following the fortunes of the down-to-earth, blue collar Conner family in the small town of Lanford, Illinois.
title: Roseanne

overview: Toru is a young part-timer who has no interest in social issues. He gets called in as a juror in the trial of a woman labeled as a "witch", charged with a murder over an enormous inheritance. Though it appears that she is definitely guilty, one by one the jurors begin casting their votes for "not guilty." From the shadows, there is a mysterious organization buying control of the jury. At the same time, strange events start happening around Toru. When another juror is threatened, Toru is determined to save her. However, Toru's girlfriend, a newspaper reporter, seems suspicious of their relationship. And so, Toru begins his lonely fight for the truth. Also called "The Witch Trial".
title: Majo Saiban

overview: From natural landscapes to historic architecture representing centuries of cultural development, Japan's World Heritage sites offer a wide range of glimpses into history and the beauty of nature.
title: The World Heritage Sites in Japan

overview: Follows a group of teenagers as they spend the summer at the Belgian seaside while searching for love, friendship and most importantly, for themselves.
title: Knokke Off

overview: Year after year, supergroups like *NSync, the Backstreet Boys, the Pussycat Dolls, Danity Kane and the Jonas Brothers carve their place in pop music history. They sing. They dance. They entertain. They inspire. Now, the search is on to find the next big pop sensation. Yes, MTV is on a mission to discover the greatest untapped talent in America! After an extensive nationwide search, nine amazing groups hit the stage to compete for a $100,000 prize and the coveted title of MTV's Top Pop Group.
title: MTV's Top Pop Group

overview: Follows safari camp owners Grant and Lynsey Cummings and their children as they take on the challenges that are unique like remodeling dilapidated lodges on their remote Zambia property.
title: Renovation Wild

overview: Le Havre, head of an organized crime group from a provincial town, is released from prison after 12 years of observation. Le Havre meets with two friends and will tell that they had a plan that he has in prison: he realized that his life is very eventful and you can make a real interesting movie about it. Le Havre believes that his film about gangsters will be true, which means it will most likely be the most diverse.
title: Кино про бандитов

overview: The series is about Olha, a 40-year-old woman who goes through a difficult life change when her husband leaves her for a younger mistress and spends all of the family's savings on gambling. Left with a bunch of debts, Olha is forced to return to work in a publishing house, from which she once refused for the sake of her family. Her life changes dramatically after a chance meeting with 26-year-old Dima, who takes her for his age.
title: Молода

overview: A multi-part comedy action movie with Vladimir Yaglych about a policeman who, having learned that he does not have long to live, decides to show himself as a real hero. Oper Boris Fadeev was not distinguished by a special zeal for work - he always sought to avoid unnecessary tasks and evade responsibility. Problems in the family, alcoholism and poor mental health complicate his already difficult life, in addition, he learns about a hereditary disease, due to which he may soon die. Not wanting to die ingloriously, Fadeev, to the surprise of those around him, is transformed and begins to take on the most difficult cases, not at all caring about his safety. Boris is sure that he will be able to leave beautifully. Here's just one catch: no matter how hard he tries, he stays alive over and over again.
title: Ухожу красиво

overview: Based on the popular 1986 Mexican program "Hora Marcada," this Spanish-language anthology series offers supernatural thrills galore. From the night watchman who's afraid of the dark to a grieving man who tries to revive his deceased wife, this inventive collection of chillers plumbs the depths of mortal terrors.
title: 13 Miedos

overview: Skimo is the story of two boys, Fito and Tavo, who made their dreams reality by opening their own shop. Skimo is described as "the coolest place in the neighbourhood". As an eatery, Skimo sells many innovative flavoured foods, like strawberry milkshakes, mango on a stick with chamoy sauce, or the vanilla ice-cream stuffed pepper.
title: Skimo

overview: Deals with the real crime that occurred in the summer of 2016 in Pioz, a small town in La Alcarria, where the lifeless bodies of a Brazilian couple and their two children, 1 and 4 years old were found. Patrick, a 19-year-old nephew of the family, was the murderer and the case took on a new dimension when it was revealed that he had shared the crime via WhatsApp with his 17-year-old best friend who lived in Brazil. The details circulated among the gang of friends, thus facing the dilemma of denouncing or leaving unpunished the murder of an entire family.
title: No Se Lo Digas a Nadie

overview: Ji Shu is the author of a melodramatic romance novel and Song Yanqi is a television producer who likes happy love stories. Both of them transmigrate in Song Yanqi's novel and end up rewriting the story, while falling in love in the process.
title: To Ship Someone

overview: Popular musician Lu En Tong and technology firm president Song Yan Xu both suffer from chronic insomnia. They come to discover that by touching one another, sleep befalls them both in a matter of seconds.
title: Mr. Insomnia Waiting for Love

overview: Party Monsters Cabo is a reality TV show airing on E!. The show involves party planners competing at the LG Villa in Cabo to see who can throw the "ultimate party" for Hollywood's A-Listers to win a contract with LG for their partys. The show is hosted by Brian Worley and Michele Merkin.
title: Party Monsters Cabo

overview: Usami Kei is a salaryman who has risen in status due to his engagement with Mei, the wealthy daughter of his company's president. Shortly after she breaks off the engagement, a power failure leaves him stuck in the elevator of his apartment building. Trapped with him are three others living on the same floor - Airu, a trilingual interpreter; Ojiro, a model photographer; and Masato, a psychiatrist. While waiting, their conversation hits upon their love lives and the question of whether there is truly only one fated partner for everyone. As a result, they decide to try "shuffling" their relationships with each other.
title: Love Shuffle

overview: Home bakers travel to Waco, TX for a competition that celebrates the joy that comes from time spent in the kitchen. Competitors try to perfect a favorite recipe for a chance to have their treat featured at Magnolia's Silos Baking Co. and win $100,000.
title: Silos Baking Competition

overview: Lindsey Kurowski is hitting the road to help struggling motel owners across America get back on track.
title: Motel Rescue

overview: In 13th century Anatolia, as the Mongol threat looms and internal turmoil rages, Rumi, a wise spiritual figure, emerges to assuage people's fears. His timeless words unite reason and compassion, inspiring change.
title: Mevlânâ Celâleddîn-i Rûmî

overview: Denver's best food trucks battle for $10,000 and an exclusive opportunity.
title: Food Truck Prize Fight

overview: Despite having no money, contacts, or social standing, aspiring artist Vgly and his crew strive to break into the music business.
title: Vgly

overview: My Universe is an anthology series following 12 diverse stories of love.
title: My Universe

overview: A sci-fi sitcom about the crew of the HMS Camden Lock in the year 2151.
title: Hyperdrive

overview: Wealthy individuals in Longcheng City have been dying one after another, and a dark shadow has been found at each crime scene. Fu Yaoyao, the captain of Longcheng City's criminal investigation team, and Jiang Zu'an, the deputy captain, quickly launched an investigation. With the full cooperation of the young chemist Zhong Shenhao, they exposed this shadow in broad daylight, leaving it with nowhere to hide. But little did they know, as one wave subsided, another arose.
title: Murder Notes

overview: After a fierce internal dispute, the brothers Polaco and César are expelled from the Barrabrava of Club Atlético Libertad del Puerto, where they remained under the orders of "El Tío". Unprotected and unable to count on a political power to protect them, the brothers will test their survival skills in a hostile and marginal world, while they prepare a war that will challenge their personal ties.
title: Barrabrava

overview: Modern Love Chennai is an eclectic bouquet of love stories – funny, quirky, deep and puzzling. While the stories converse with your heart, you also catch a glimpse into the soul of Chennai with its unique terrains and diverse inhabitants.
title: Modern Love Chennai

overview: Frank Stimpel, Germany's most German teacher - correct, obsessed with rules, lactose intolerant - is finally allowed to teach at a troubled school. Everything is at stake for him now, because his teacher's exam is coming up. If he doesn't make it, that's it. The unflinching Alman has to prove himself in a world that works differently than described in his teacher's guide.
title: Almania

overview: Matt, an American journalist, and his fiancée, Jessie, are killed in an explosion, but reawaken in a very unusual afterlife - a mysterious planet with an endless river terrain. Everyone who has ever lived on Earth has been resurrected simultaneously in this strange new world. Determined to find Jessie, Matt joins forces with an intrepid crew including a 13th century female warrior and Riverboat captain Mark Twain. Embarking upriver, their adventure begins, all the while tracked by the watchful eye of a mysterious alien force.
title: Riverworld

overview: On the eve of graduation, Wang Yangming, who took reversing heart failure as his mission, had a disagreement with his supervisor in medical experiments, and resolutely decided to switch from scientific research to clinical practice, and successfully joined the emergency department of Ruiren Hospital, which ranked first in the country. Wang Yangming's competitive instinct was aroused by his busy life in the emergency department, when he took risks to deal with ventricular fibrillation in the elderly, rescued heat stroke migrant workers, treated stroke patients, and so on, constantly refined his medical skills. At the same time , on the ward formed group named "four masters of emergency medicine" , which Yang's Ming is a part, alongside with Lu Qing Qi, Zu Wen Da and Liu Fei. Now four of them, witness each other's growth and change, gain friendship and love, and experience dispersion and separation on their ward.
title: The White Castle

overview: It tells the magnificent Xianxia story of Wei Zhi, the female protagonist who is reincarnated as a phoenix, and Yan Yue, the male protagonist who is the Sun God. They go through hardships and finally break the destiny of how the "phoenix nirvana will shake the three worlds" and rewrite their own Xianxia story together.
title: Beauty of Resilience

overview: In The Office Australia, Hannah Howard is the managing director of packaging company Flinley Craddick.When she gets news from Head Office that they will be shutting down her branch and making everyone work from home, she goes into survival mode, making promises she can't keep in order to keep her "work family" together. The staff of Flinley Craddick indulge her and must endure Hannah's outlandish plots as they work toward the impossible targets that have been set for them.
title: The Office

overview: Pop Britannia explores our flair for pop, our fascination with finding our own pop voice and our obsession with style and the imagery of empire and nationhood.
title: Pop Britannia

overview: Designer and mom of two, Veronica Valencia and her team, will meet with clients to learn about their family background and meaningful moments from their past. In each episode, she'll consult with a genealogist to learn more about her clients' cultural identity and create a life-size mood board inspired by the aesthetic details of their family story. Veronica and her expert team consisting of design guru Tommy Rouse, master builder David Bohler and talented artist Joshua Smith will then transform the home, creating beautiful and modern spaces that honor the family's cultural heritage. She also will include special heirloom projects, such as artwork and artifacts, that weave the homeowners' personal legacy into the overall design.
title: Revealed

overview: From the creators of the show "Four Weddings." Couples have fumed and fumed their weddings and even decided whose celebration is better. But fading their weddings is just the beginning: now these same girls will once again enter the fray to find out who is the best wife.
title: Четыре жены

overview: The story revolves around a young woman named Mei, who was rescued as a young girl by someone calling himself her "butler." With only a vague memory, though, the experience seems like just a dream. But one day, after her parents' accidental death, he appears: Rihito comes from a line of outstanding butlers, and he has been appointed to serve her! Now her ordinary life has completely flipped, as she discovers that she's actually the heiress to a fortune, and is forced to transfer to St. Lucia Girls' Academy, where all the students have butlers! As a result, her childhood friend Kento decides to enroll in a butler school so that he can stay close to her.
title: Mei-chan no Shitsuji

overview: The Fenway Bowl is an NCAA Division I Football Bowl Subdivision college football bowl game played at Fenway Park in Boston, Massachusetts. Organized by ESPN Events and Fenway Sports Management, it features teams from the American Athletic Conference and the Atlantic Coast Conference. Upon its inaugural playing in 2022, it became the fourth active bowl game staged in a baseball stadium, along with the Pinstripe Bowl (Yankee Stadium), the Holiday Bowl (Petco Park) and Guaranteed Rate Bowl (Chase Field). American football games at Fenway Park date to at least 1916. Various professional and college football teams have played at Fenway, including the Boston Patriots during the American Football League (AFL) era, and the Boston College Eagles. Prior to the Fenway Bowl, no bowl game had been scheduled for the ballpark. On December 17, 2022, as part of the 2022–23 bowl season, the Fenway Bowl was played for the first time, featuring Cincinnati and Louisville.
title: Fenway Bowl

overview: Is what you see real? Does your mind control you? Discover how your brain really works.
title: Your Brain

overview: As kids, Kazuma Takizawa and Ren Ishihara were the best of friends. Nearly inseparable, the two did everything together. But when they reached their third year of middle school, everything changed. Forced to move to America, Kazuma left with almost no warning, bringing his friendship with Ren to a very abrupt and unexpected end. Ten years later, Kazuma is back in Japan and excited to begin his new job. Completely unaware that Ren is now working as the company's top designer, Kazuma is shocked to see his old friend again. Thrilled to be reunited with Ren, Kazuma hopes they'll be able to pick up where they left off, but Ren seems to want nothing to do with him. Keeping Kazuma at a friendly distance, Ren acts more like a former classmate than a former best friend. Struggling to understand why Ren is being so cold, Kazuma decides being around Ren at work is enough. Content to have him back in his life, Ren tells himself he's happy, though deep down, he hopes to have his old friend back soon. With time, will he be able to win back the affection of his best friend and first love?
title: Tokyo in April is...

overview: Hao Nan, a teacher who is nearing his thirties, faces a bunch of high school students who were abandoned by society and deemed as losers. He decides to help these students regain their confidence, working hand-in-hand with them to redeem themselves and create miracles. Together, they complete their high school entrance examinations, galloping toward hope and dreams.
title: Ray of Light

overview: It tells the ups and downs of a group of young people in Beijing during the 1970s, reflecting the changing times through the struggles of the "little people" and depicting the next generation amidst a wave of reform and opening up. Xiao Chunsheng along with his two buddies Ye Guohua and Chen Hongjun, are children of military families and government workers who grew up in the same courtyard. They share many experiences like joining the army, taking the gaokao, going out to sea, and starting a business, while supporting each other the entire way. They also meet Tong Xiaomei, a Beijing girl pursuing her dreams of becoming a doctor.
title: Where Dreams Begin
